fields.Name: W1 -> S5.4 #3
fields.Description: Gate G2.32 (phase 2, dataset W1, criterion S5.4 #3): 100% of W1-signal s42 training runs record, in the model lineage, the library versions (python, numpy, scikit-learn, xgboost, lightgbm) and the thread count they ran with, and a run whose lineage lacks either is refused, 1 of 1. It fails when TrainerRunRecorder.ApplyTrainerResultToRun skips TrainerContract.CodeVersionGaps, so a lineage-incomplete run completes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The trainer's CodeVersion records the python, numpy, scikit-learn, xgboost and lightgbm versions and the thread count (1 of 1 pytest case passes), and a completed result whose lineage lacks scikit-learn is refused with the run left Failed.
